title: agentic ai: a comprehensive survey of architectures, applications, and future directions
core_idea: Introduce a dual-paradigm framework that distinguishes agentic systems into symbolic/classical (algorithmic planning, persistent state) and neural/generative (stochastic generation, prompt-driven orchestration) lineages, and conduct a PRISMA-based systematic review (90 studies, 2018–2025) to analyze theoretical foundations, domain-specific implementations (healthcare, finance, robotics), and paradigm-specific ethical and governance considerations.
tldr: A focused survey proposing a dual-paradigm taxonomy for agentic AI and systematically reviewing literature to clarify concepts, compare architectural principles and application patterns, and provide a conceptual toolkit to inform future research, development, and policy.
